creators.name: Kevin McCoy
creators.bio: Artist who works with Jennifer McCoy on media installations and, in 2014, minted Quantum on Namecoin while building Monegraph with Anil Dash at Rhizome's Seven on Seven.
creators.why: He made one of the first blockchain-registered artworks and a protocol for certifying digital images.
creators.bio_zh: 长期与 Jennifer McCoy 合作媒体装置的艺术家；2014 年在 Rhizome 的 Seven on Seven 活动中与 Anil Dash 一起搭建 Monegraph，并在 Namecoin 上铸造了 Quantum。
creators.why_zh: 他创作了最早在区块链上登记的艺术作品之一，并设计了认证数字图像的协议。

creators.name: Anil Dash
creators.bio: Technologist and writer who co-created Monegraph with Kevin McCoy at Rhizome's Seven on Seven in 2014.
creators.why: Co-author of Monegraph, an early protocol for owning digital art on a blockchain.
creators.bio_zh: 技术专家与作家，2014 年在 Rhizome 的 Seven on Seven 活动中与 Kevin McCoy 共同创建 Monegraph。
creators.why_zh: Monegraph 的共同作者，这是在区块链上拥有数字艺术的早期协议。

creators.name: Sarah Meyohas
creators.bio: Artist whose work deals with value, speculation and systems; in 2015 she launched Bitchcoin, a currency redeemable for her photographs, and in 2017 staged Cloud of Petals.
creators.why: Bitchcoin made an artist's own currency, backed by her work, years before NFTs.
creators.bio_zh: 作品关注价值、投机与系统的艺术家；2015 年推出可兑换其摄影作品的货币 Bitchcoin，2017 年创作 Cloud of Petals。
creators.why_zh: Bitchcoin 在 NFT 出现数年前就把艺术家自己的作品变成了支撑一种货币的储备。

creators.name: Rare Pepe Directory
creators.bio: Self-styled team of 'Rare Pepe Scientists' who from 2016 certified user-made Pepe trading cards issued as Counterparty assets and fed them to Pepe wallets.
creators.why: Their published submission rules turned a meme community into an open, rule-bound issuance system for crypto art.
creators.bio_zh: 自称“Rare Pepe 科学家”的团队，自 2016 年起认证用户制作、以 Counterparty 资产发行的 Pepe 卡牌，并把它们推送到 Pepe 钱包中。
creators.why_zh: 他们公布的投稿规则，把一个表情包社群变成了开放而有规则的加密艺术发行系统。

creators.name: Joe Looney
creators.bio: Developer in the Counterparty community who built the Rare Pepe Wallet, derived from his BTCPAY Market, to collect, display and trade Rare Pepes.
creators.why: His wallet gave the Rare Pepe rules a place where the community could hold and exchange cards.
creators.bio_zh: Counterparty 社群的开发者，基于自己的 BTCPAY Market 构建了 Rare Pepe Wallet，用于收藏、展示和交易 Rare Pepe。
creators.why_zh: 他的钱包让 Rare Pepe 的规则有了一个社群可以持有和交换卡牌的地方。

creators.name: Curio Cards
creators.role: Ethereum art project (Travis Uhrig, Thomas Hunt, Rhett Creighton)
creators.bio: Project created by Travis Uhrig, Thomas Hunt and Rhett Creighton that released 30 card series by seven artists on Ethereum in 2017, with all sale proceeds going to the artists.
creators.why: One of the first art NFT projects on Ethereum, later revived and governed by its collectors.
creators.role_zh: 以太坊艺术项目（Travis Uhrig、Thomas Hunt、Rhett Creighton）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Travis Uhrig、Thomas Hunt 和 Rhett Creighton 创建的项目，2017 年在以太坊上发布七位艺术家的 30 个卡牌系列，销售收入全部归艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 以太坊上最早的艺术 NFT 项目之一，后来由藏家社群重新激活并治理。

creators.name: Larva Labs
creators.bio: Two-person studio of Canadian software developers Matt Hall and John Watkinson, creators of CryptoPunks (2017) and Autoglyphs (2019).
creators.why: They wrote the claim-and-trade rules and the on-chain generator that later NFT art took as templates.
creators.role_zh: 工作室（Matt Hall 与 John Watkinson）
creators.bio_zh: 由加拿大软件开发者 Matt Hall 和 John Watkinson 组成的两人工作室，创作了 CryptoPunks（2017）和 Autoglyphs（2019）。
creators.why_zh: 他们写下的“认领—交易”规则和链上生成器，成为后来 NFT 艺术的模板。

creators.name: Kevin Abosch
creators.bio: Irish conceptual artist working in photography, blockchain, sculpture and AI; he lives in Paris and teaches at the University of Applied Arts Vienna.
creators.why: His 2018 token works split, gift and co-own value among strangers.
creators.bio_zh: 爱尔兰观念艺术家，创作涉及摄影、区块链、雕塑与人工智能；现居巴黎，任教于维也纳应用艺术大学。
creators.why_zh: 他 2018 年的代币作品让价值在陌生人之间被分割、赠与和共同拥有。

creators.name: Moxie Marlinspike
creators.bio: Cryptographer and founder of Signal who, in 2021, built two small Ethereum projects to test web3 and wrote about them in 'My first impressions of web3' (2022).
creators.why: His experiments exposed that NFT ownership and collective art depend on servers and platforms outside the contract.
creators.bio_zh: 密码学家、Signal 的创始人。2021 年他搭建了两个小型以太坊项目来测试 web3，并在 2022 年的文章《My first impressions of web3》中记述。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验揭示：NFT 所有权和集体艺术其实依赖合约之外的服务器与平台。

creators.name: Peter Porobov
creators.bio: Self-taught developer who made The Million Ether Homepage, an Ethereum version of the Million Dollar Homepage, in 2016 and relaunched it with ERC-721 blocks in 2018.
creators.why: He turned a shared ad canvas into a contract with referral chains, rent and resale.
creators.bio_zh: 自学成才的开发者，2016 年制作了以太坊版“百万美元首页”The Million Ether Homepage，2018 年以 ERC-721 地块重新上线。
creators.why_zh: 他把一块共享广告画布写成了带推荐链、出租与转售的合约。

creators.name: Cyrus Adkisson
creators.bio: Developer who deployed Etheria, a world of ownable hexagonal land tiles, on Ethereum in October 2015 and demoed it at DEVCON 1.
creators.why: Etheria is one of the earliest shared worlds whose land and buildings are held and made by players under contract rules.
creators.bio_zh: 开发者，2015 年 10 月在以太坊上部署了由可拥有的六边形地块组成的世界 Etheria，并在 DEVCON 1 上演示。
creators.why_zh: Etheria 是最早的共享世界之一，土地和建筑都在合约规则下由玩家持有和建造。

creators.name: William Entriken
creators.bio: Developer and lead author of the ERC-721 standard who launched Su Squares, 10,000 personalizable squares on Ethereum, in 2018.
creators.why: Su Squares makes a collective image out of what each owner puts in their square.
creators.bio_zh: 开发者，ERC-721 标准的主要作者，2018 年推出 Su Squares：以太坊上可个性化的 10,000 个方格。
creators.why_zh: Su Squares 用每位持有者放进自己方格里的内容拼成一幅集体图像。

creators.name: Dapper Labs
creators.role: Game studio (spun off from Axiom Zen)
creators.bio: Vancouver studio spun off from Axiom Zen in 2018 to run CryptoKitties; its CTO Dieter Shirley first proposed the ERC-721 standard.
creators.why: CryptoKitties showed what happens when breeding rules meet a crowd on a shared blockchain.
creators.role_zh: 游戏工作室（由 Axiom Zen 分拆）
creators.bio_zh: 位于温哥华、2018 年从 Axiom Zen 分拆出来运营 CryptoKitties 的工作室；其 CTO Dieter Shirley 最早提出了 ERC-721 标准。
creators.why_zh: CryptoKitties 展示了繁殖规则遇上人群、并共享一条区块链时会发生什么。

creators.name: Rafael Lima
creators.role: Developer, founder of Hic et Nunc
creators.bio: Former social scientist from Brasília who built Hic et Nunc on Tezos, describing it as a 'social laboratory', and shut its website down on 11 November 2021.
creators.why: He published open contracts that outlived his own withdrawal, as he had intended.
creators.role_zh: 开发者、Hic et Nunc 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 来自巴西利亚的前社会科学研究者，在 Tezos 上构建了 Hic et Nunc，称之为“社会实验室”；2021 年 11 月 11 日关闭了其网站。
creators.why_zh: 他发布的开放合约如他所愿，在他本人退出后依然存续。

creators.name: Teia Community
creators.bio: Volunteer community of artists, developers and collectors that took over the Hic et Nunc contracts after November 2021, named itself Teia by on-chain vote and registered as a non-profit DAO LLC in 2023.
creators.why: Teia shows a community keeping an abandoned art protocol alive and governing it collectively.
creators.role_zh: 社群运营的 NFT 平台与 DAO
creators.bio_zh: 由艺术家、开发者和藏家组成的志愿者社群，2021 年 11 月后接手 Hic et Nunc 的合约，通过链上投票命名为 Teia，并于 2023 年注册为非营利 DAO LLC。
creators.why_zh: Teia 展示了一个社群如何让被遗弃的艺术协议继续运转并集体治理它。

creators.name: Egor Kraft
creators.bio: Artist born in St. Petersburg and raised in Sweden who lives in Vienna and Tokyo; his practice draws on media theory, computer science, critical design and film.
creators.why: Hashd0x turns blockchain provenance into a shared protocol for citizen evidence of war.
creators.bio_zh: 生于圣彼得堡、在瑞典长大的艺术家，现居维也纳和东京；创作融合媒介理论、计算机科学、批判设计与电影。
creators.why_zh: Hashd0x 把区块链来源证明变成公民记录战争证据的共享协议。
creators.based_zh: 维也纳，奥地利 / 东京，日本

works.title: Quantum
works.description: A looping animation of a pulsing octagon registered on the Namecoin blockchain on 3 May 2014, often cited as the first blockchain-registered artwork.
works.description_zh: 一段搏动的八边形循环动画，于 2014 年 5 月 3 日在 Namecoin 区块链上登记，常被称为第一件在区块链上登记的艺术作品。
works.idea_en: A registry entry is ownership only for as long as someone keeps renewing it.
works.idea_zh: 登记条目只有在有人持续续期时才构成所有权。
works.protocol: The work was recorded as a Namecoin name entry pointing to the image. Namecoin names must be renewed by their holder (every 250 days, as reported); an unrenewed name can be claimed by anyone.
works.protocol_zh: 作品以指向图像的 Namecoin 域名条目登记。Namecoin 名称必须由持有者定期续期（据报道每 250 天一次）；未续期的名称任何人都可以认领。
works.collective: McCoy did not renew the record in 2015. In 2021 he re-minted Quantum on Ethereum and Sotheby's sold it for $1.47 million; a Canadian company, Free Holdings, which had claimed the lapsed Namecoin entry, sued McCoy and Sotheby's, and a New York court dismissed the case.
works.collective_zh: McCoy 在 2015 年没有续期。2021 年他在以太坊上重新铸造 Quantum，苏富比以 147 万美元售出；一家认领了失效 Namecoin 条目的加拿大公司 Free Holdings 起诉 McCoy 和苏富比，纽约法院驳回了诉讼。

works.title: Monegraph
works.description: A system built in one day at Rhizome's Seven on Seven 2014 that let anyone certify a web image on the Namecoin blockchain and tweet out public proof of ownership.
works.description_zh: 在 2014 年 Rhizome 的 Seven on Seven 活动中一天内搭建完成的系统，让任何人都能在 Namecoin 区块链上认证一张网络图像，并发推公开证明所有权。
works.idea_en: Scarcity for digital images comes from a public claim, not from the file.
works.idea_zh: 数字图像的稀缺性来自公开的声明，而不是文件本身。
works.protocol: An artist registers a claim linking an image to their identity on a blockchain; only the original file passes validation against that claim, though copies circulate freely. Registered works can be owned and traded.
works.protocol_zh: 艺术家在区块链上登记一项声明，把图像与自己的身份关联；图像可以自由复制传播，但只有原始文件能通过该声明的验证。登记过的作品可以被拥有和交易。
works.collective: Monegraph opened the claim mechanism to other artists and collectors, becoming a template for later NFT platforms; the McCoys' Public Key/Private Key at the Whitney (2019) used it to make 50 people donors of a museum work.
works.collective_zh: Monegraph 把登记机制开放给其他艺术家和藏家，成为后来 NFT 平台的模板；McCoy 夫妇 2019 年在惠特尼美术馆的 Public Key/Private Key 就用它让 50 个人成为一件馆藏作品的捐赠者。

works.title: Bitchcoin
works.description: An artist's currency launched in February 2015 and backed by her photographs: 25 Bitchcoins could be redeemed for a whole print of her Speculations series, stored in a vault.
works.description_zh: 艺术家于 2015 年 2 月推出、以自己摄影作品作储备的货币：25 枚 Bitchcoin 可以兑换一整张存放在保险库中的 Speculations 系列照片。
works.idea_en: Back a currency with your own art and let the market price the artist.
works.idea_zh: 用自己的作品作为货币储备，让市场为艺术家定价。
works.protocol: One Bitchcoin was fixed to 25 square inches of a Speculations photograph. Eight editions of the first Speculation backed 200 coins released at $100 each; buyers got a paper wallet with their keys and could exchange 25 coins for a print. In 2021 the currency migrated to ERC-1155 tokens backed by pressed rose petals from Cloud of Petals.
works.protocol_zh: 一枚 Bitchcoin 固定对应 Speculations 照片的 25 平方英寸。第一张 Speculation 的八个版次支撑了 200 枚、每枚 100 美元发行的币；买家获得记有密钥的纸钱包，可用 25 枚兑换一张照片。2021 年这种货币迁移为 ERC-1155 代币，改由 Cloud of Petals 中压制的玫瑰花瓣作储备。
works.collective: Buyers speculated on the artist as a currency. Earlier holders could claim equivalent new tokens after the migration, which were offered at Phillips in May 2021; in 2023 the Centre Pompidou acquired two Bitchcoins.
works.collective_zh: 买家把艺术家当作一种货币来投机。迁移后原持有者可以领取等量的新代币，新代币于 2021 年 5 月在富艺斯上拍；2023 年蓬皮杜中心收藏了两枚 Bitchcoin。

works.title: Rare Pepes
works.description: User-made Pepe trading cards issued as Counterparty assets on Bitcoin and certified by the Rare Pepe Directory under published submission rules.
works.description_zh: 由用户制作、以 Counterparty 资产形式在比特币上发行、并由 Rare Pepe Directory 按公开投稿规则认证的 Pepe 卡牌。
works.idea_en: Publish the issuing rules and let a meme community become an art scene.
works.idea_zh: 公布发行规则，让一个表情包社群变成一个艺术圈。
works.protocol: Any artist could create a Counterparty asset and submit it for a fee of 200 PEPECASH, half of which was burned. Rules: 400×560 images, animated GIFs under 1.5 MB, issuance locked, not divisible, 100 to 100,000 shares, something to do with Pepe, original work, no NSFW, no websites or QR codes, one submission per artist per day. Approved cards appeared in Rare Pepe wallets.
works.protocol_zh: 任何艺术家都可以创建 Counterparty 资产并提交，费用为 200 PEPECASH，其中一半被销毁。规则：图像 400×560，动图小于 1.5 MB，发行量锁定、不可分割、份数在 100 到 100,000 之间，内容与 Pepe 有关且为原创，禁止成人内容，不得包含网址或二维码，每位艺术家每天只能提交一次。通过审核的卡牌会出现在 Rare Pepe 钱包中。
works.collective: Dozens of artists around the world submitted cards; the directory certified over 1,700 rares across its series before closing submissions so the rareness could 'bake in'. The first cards date from September 2016.
works.collective_zh: 世界各地数十位艺术家提交了卡牌；在关闭投稿、让稀有性“定型”之前，目录在各系列中共认证了 1,700 多张稀有卡。第一批卡牌出现在 2016 年 9 月。

works.title: Rare Pepe Wallet
works.description: A web wallet and marketplace launched on 14 September 2016 for collecting, displaying and trading Rare Pepe cards on Counterparty.
works.description_zh: 2016 年 9 月 14 日上线的网页钱包与市场，用于在 Counterparty 上收藏、展示和交易 Rare Pepe 卡牌。
works.idea_en: Give a rule-bound art community a shared place to hold and swap its tokens.
works.idea_zh: 给一个有规则的艺术社群一个共同持有和交换代币的地方。
works.protocol: The wallet shows only cards certified by the Rare Pepe Directory, and lets holders send, buy and sell them peer to peer on the Counterparty decentralised exchange.
works.protocol_zh: 钱包只显示经 Rare Pepe Directory 认证的卡牌，持有者可以在 Counterparty 去中心化交易所上点对点发送、买卖。
works.collective: The wallet became the Rare Pepe community's marketplace and gallery; in January 2018 a Homer Pepe card was auctioned at the Rare Digital Art Festival in New York.
works.collective_zh: 钱包成为 Rare Pepe 社群的市场和展厅；2018 年 1 月，一张 Homer Pepe 卡在纽约 Rare Digital Art Festival 上拍卖。

works.title: Curio Cards
works.description: Thirty digital card series by seven artists, each deployed as its own fixed-supply token contract on Ethereum from 9 May 2017, sold through a vending-machine interface with all proceeds going to the artists.
works.description_zh: 七位艺术家的三十个数字卡牌系列，自 2017 年 5 月 9 日起在以太坊上各自部署为固定供应的代币合约，通过“自动售货机”式界面出售，收入全部归艺术家。
works.idea_en: Scarce digital prints sold directly for artists, then kept alive by collectors.
works.idea_zh: 为艺术家直接出售的稀缺数字版画，后来由藏家维系下去。
works.protocol: Each card is a modified ERC-20 contract with a limited, non-divisible supply and the artwork's IPFS hash embedded; buying from the contract sends payment to the artist. A misprint produced an extra card, 17b.
works.protocol_zh: 每张卡都是一个修改过的 ERC-20 合约，供应有限且不可分割，并嵌入作品的 IPFS 哈希；从合约购买时款项直接付给艺术家。一次印错产生了额外的一张卡 17b。
works.collective: Cards sold for $0.50–$1 at launch. After 2021 collectors rediscovered them, an ERC-1155 wrapper contract written by a community member made them tradable on OpenSea, and a complete set including 17b sold at Christie's in October 2021 for 393 ETH.
works.collective_zh: 上线时每张卡售价 0.5 至 1 美元。2021 年藏家重新发现它们后，一位社群成员编写的 ERC-1155 包装合约使其可在 OpenSea 交易；同年 10 月，含 17b 的全套卡牌在佳士得以 393 ETH 成交。

works.title: CryptoPunks
works.description: Ten thousand 24×24-pixel characters generated by algorithm and released in June 2017 free to anyone with an Ethereum wallet, with a marketplace built into the contract.
works.description_zh: 一万个由算法生成的 24×24 像素角色，于 2017 年 6 月免费发放给任何拥有以太坊钱包的人，合约内置交易市场。
works.idea_en: Give art away under simple ownership rules and let collectors invent its culture.
works.idea_zh: 在简单的所有权规则下把作品送出去，让藏家发明它的文化。
works.protocol: Anyone could claim an unowned punk for only the gas fee. The contract itself lets owners offer punks for sale (to anyone or one address), accept bids, withdraw and transfer, with no platform in between.
works.protocol_zh: 任何人只需支付 gas 即可认领一个无主的 punk。合约本身允许持有者挂单出售（面向所有人或指定地址）、接受出价、撤回和转让，中间没有任何平台。
works.collective: It took eight days for all 10,000 to be claimed. Collectors made punks their profile pictures and built a shared vocabulary of 'floor price', 'rarity' and 'traits'; according to Larva Labs, total sales reached about $3.8 billion by October 2025, and punks entered MoMA, LACMA, ICA Miami and the Centre Pompidou.
works.collective_zh: 一万个 punk 用了八天才被全部认领。藏家把 punk 用作头像，并形成了“地板价”“稀有度”“特征”等共同词汇；据 Larva Labs 统计，截至 2025 年 10 月总成交额约 38 亿美元，punk 进入了 MoMA、LACMA、迈阿密 ICA 和蓬皮杜中心的收藏。

works.title: Autoglyphs
works.description: The first generative art whose algorithm runs and stores its output entirely on-chain: each collector's mint transaction executes the generator and produces one of at most 512 glyphs.
works.description_zh: 第一件算法与输出都完全在链上的生成艺术：每位藏家的铸造交易都会执行生成器，产出至多 512 个字形中的一个。
works.idea_en: The collector performs the artist's algorithm, as assistants once drew Sol LeWitt's instructions.
works.idea_zh: 由藏家执行艺术家的算法，就像当年助手照着索尔·勒维特的指令作画。
works.protocol: Anyone could pay 0.2 ETH to run the generator in the contract; the artists could neither choose nor intervene in outputs once deployed. Supply was capped at 512, and the contract includes instructions for turning the text rendering into a drawing with any tools.
works.protocol_zh: 任何人支付 0.2 ETH 即可运行合约中的生成器；部署之后艺术家既不能挑选、也不能干预输出。供应上限为 512，合约还附有指令，说明如何用任意工具把文字渲染转成图画。
works.collective: All 512 glyphs were minted within four hours, donating $13,670 to 350.org; during minting the contract consumed 13.27% of Ethereum's network capacity. Glyphs have been drawn with pen plotters following the contract's instructions, and the Whitney and Centre Pompidou hold examples.
works.collective_zh: 全部 512 个字形在四小时内被铸造完毕，向 350.org 捐赠 13,670 美元；铸造期间合约占用了以太坊网络 13.27% 的容量。人们按合约中的指令用绘图仪把字形画了出来，惠特尼美术馆和蓬皮杜中心都有收藏。

works.title: IAMA Coin
works.description: Ten million divisible IAMA tokens on Ethereum paired with 100 physical works on which the artist stamped the token's contract address in his own blood.
works.description_zh: 以太坊上一千万枚可分割的 IAMA 代币，配合 100 件实体作品，艺术家用自己的血在作品上印下代币的合约地址。
works.idea_en: The artist declares himself a coin and lets others hold, split and spend him.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家宣布自己是一枚硬币，让别人持有、分割和花费他。
works.protocol: The physical works exist only because the virtual tokens exist: each is marked in blood with the contract address that defines 10,000,000 divisible IAMA tokens, which can circulate like any ERC-20 currency.
works.protocol_zh: 实体作品的意义以虚拟代币为前提：每件都用血印上合约地址，该合约定义了 10,000,000 枚可分割、可像任何 ERC-20 货币一样流通的 IAMA 代币。
works.collective: IAMA circulated as a currency among collectors; it was one of the two tokens used to pay for Forever Rose in February 2018.
works.collective_zh: IAMA 作为货币在藏家之间流通；2018 年 2 月购买 Forever Rose 时使用的两种代币之一就是它。

works.title: Forever Rose
works.description: A single ERC-20 token called ROSE, based on the artist's photograph of a rose, sold on Valentine's Day 2018 with the gifting platform GIFTO to ten collectors who each received a tenth of it.
works.description_zh: 一枚名为 ROSE 的 ERC-20 代币，基于艺术家拍摄的一张玫瑰照片，2018 年情人节通过赠礼平台 GIFTO 售给十位藏家，每人获得十分之一。
works.idea_en: One artwork, one token, ten owners.
works.idea_zh: 一件作品，一枚代币，十位持有者。
works.protocol: The work exists as one divisible token. A ballot chose ten buyers, who split the price evenly and each received 0.1 ROSE; payment was made in GTO and IAMA tokens, and the proceeds went to the CoderDojo Foundation.
works.protocol_zh: 作品以一枚可分割的代币存在。通过抽选确定十位买家，他们平分价格，每人获得 0.1 ROSE；款项以 GTO 和 IAMA 代币支付，全部捐给 CoderDojo 基金会。
works.collective: The ten collectors each paid the equivalent of $100,000, co-owning a work sold for $1 million in total.
works.collective_zh: 十位藏家每人支付相当于 10 万美元的代币，共同拥有这件总价 100 万美元的作品。

works.title: PRICELESS (with Ai Weiwei)
works.description: A collaboration with Ai Weiwei made of two ERC-20 tokens, PRICELESS (PRCLS): one is locked away forever, the other is given away in fractions to collectors.
works.description_zh: 与艾未未合作的作品，由两枚 ERC-20 代币 PRICELESS（PRCLS）组成：一枚永远不可获得，另一枚被分成碎片免费赠给藏家。
works.idea_en: Make a token priceless by never selling it, only giving it away.
works.idea_zh: 让一枚代币变得“无价”：永远不卖，只赠送。
works.protocol: Each token is divisible to 18 decimal places. One is made unavailable to anyone; the other is distributed for free to collectors, down to a quintillionth at a time. Small amounts were deposited into wallets whose printed addresses form a series of physical works.
works.protocol_zh: 每枚代币可分割到小数点后 18 位。一枚永远不可被任何人获得；另一枚免费分发给藏家，每次可小到百亿亿分之一。少量代币被存入一些钱包，这些钱包地址被印刷成一系列实体作品。
works.collective: Recipients share fragments of one token that has no market price; each wallet address stands for a moment shared by the two artists.
works.collective_zh: 接收者分享同一枚没有市场价格的代币的碎片；每个钱包地址代表两位艺术家共同度过的一个时刻。

works.title: AtMyWhim
works.description: An NFT whose image changes depending on who is looking: it appeared one way on OpenSea, another on Rarible, and as a large poop emoji in the buyer's wallet.
works.description_zh: 一个会因观看者不同而改变图像的 NFT：在 OpenSea 上是一种样子，在 Rarible 上是另一种，而在买家的钱包里则是一个巨大的便便表情。
works.idea_en: What you bid on is not what you get: an NFT points to a server, not to an image.
works.idea_zh: 你竞拍的不是你得到的：NFT 指向的是一台服务器，而不是一张图像。
works.protocol: The token's metadata points to a URL with no hash commitment; the server behind it returns different images based on the requester's IP address or user agent, which the NFT standard allows.
works.protocol_zh: 代币元数据指向一个没有哈希承诺的 URL；背后的服务器根据请求者的 IP 或 User Agent 返回不同图像，而 NFT 标准允许这样做。
works.collective: Marketplaces, not collectors, decided the outcome: after a few days OpenSea removed the NFT without explanation, and it then also disappeared from crypto wallets that rely on OpenSea's API.
works.collective_zh: 决定结果的不是藏家，而是市场平台：几天后 OpenSea 在未作解释的情况下下架了这个 NFT，随后它也从依赖 OpenSea API 的加密钱包中消失了。

works.title: Autonomous Art
works.description: A collective on-chain image to which anyone can add a visual contribution, minting an NFT of the work at that moment; each contribution costs more than the last, and the payment is shared among earlier contributors.
works.description_zh: 一幅集体的链上图像，任何人都可以往上添加一笔视觉贡献，同时铸造一个记录作品当下状态的 NFT；每次贡献都比上一次更贵，所付款项分给之前的贡献者。
works.idea_en: Pay to add to a shared picture, and get paid by everyone who comes after you.
works.idea_zh: 付钱给共享画面添一笔，再由后来的每一个人付钱给你。
works.protocol: Anyone can mint by adding shapes to the shared on-chain SVG. The cost of contributing rises over time, and the funds a contributor pays are distributed to all previous artists, a structure the author compares to a pyramid.
works.protocol_zh: 任何人都可以通过向共享的链上 SVG 添加图形来铸造。贡献成本随时间上升，贡献者支付的资金分配给之前的所有艺术家，作者把这种结构比作金字塔。
works.collective: By early January 2022 contributors had put over $38,000 into the collective piece, according to the author; the contract lists over 600 contributions.
works.collective_zh: 据作者说，到 2022 年 1 月初，贡献者已为这件集体作品投入超过 38,000 美元；合约中记录了 600 多次贡献。

works.title: The Million Ether Homepage
works.description: A 1000×1000-pixel web page on Ethereum where anyone can buy, rent and resell blocks of pixels and place an image ad in them, after the 2005 Million Dollar Homepage.
works.description_zh: 一个位于以太坊上的 1000×1000 像素网页，任何人都可以购买、租用和转售像素块并在其中放置图片广告，仿照 2005 年的“百万美元首页”。
works.idea_en: A shared canvas assembled by whoever pays, with the price rising as it fills.
works.idea_zh: 一块由付费者拼成的共享画布，越满越贵。
works.protocol: Pixels are sold in 10×10 blocks; the price doubles each time a further share of the field is sold (every 100,000 pixels in 2016, every 10% in 2018). Owners can place and replace ads, sell at any price or rent out by the day. The 2016 version paid referrers along chains up to six 'handshakes' deep; the 2018 version made each block an ERC-721 token and sends 80% of initial sales to charity.
works.protocol_zh: 像素以 10×10 为一块出售；每卖出一定比例，价格翻倍（2016 年每 100,000 像素，2018 年每 10%）。持有者可以放置和替换广告、以任意价格转售或按天出租。2016 年版本沿着最多六层“握手”的推荐链向推荐人分成；2018 年版本把每个像素块做成 ERC-721 代币，并把首次销售的 80% 捐给慈善机构。
works.collective: The page's image is a mosaic of ads chosen by buyers and renters; both versions are now paused while the author considers moving the 2018 blocks back to the 2016 contract.
works.collective_zh: 页面图像是买家和租户所选广告拼成的马赛克；两个版本目前都已暂停，作者正在考虑把 2018 年的像素块迁回 2016 年的合约。

works.title: Etheria
works.description: A 3D world of ownable, tradable hexagonal land tiles deployed on Ethereum in October 2015, in four versions of the same 33×33 map, on which owners can build.
works.description_zh: 2015 年 10 月部署在以太坊上的三维世界，由可拥有、可交易的六边形地块组成，同一张 33×33 地图有四个版本，持有者可以在地块上建造。
works.idea_en: A shared world whose land and buildings exist only as contract state written by players.
works.idea_zh: 一个共享世界，土地和建筑只以玩家写入的合约状态存在。
works.protocol: Each map version has 457 ownable land tiles among 632 ocean tiles; tiles were originally sold at a hardcoded price of 1 ETH and can be traded. Owners can build on their tile; since 2021 build data is stored in each tile's unlimited name field, making builds far cheaper.
works.protocol_zh: 每个地图版本有 457 块可拥有的陆地和 632 块海洋；地块最初以写死在合约里的 1 ETH 价格出售，可以交易。持有者可以在地块上建造；自 2021 年起建造数据存放在每块地无限长的名称字段中，建造成本大幅下降。
works.collective: Of the 1,828 tiles across four versions, the project estimates 5–10% are permanently lost; since the 2021 revival owners have been adding new builds to the unified map.
works.collective_zh: 四个版本共 1,828 块地，项目估计其中 5% 至 10% 已永久丢失；自 2021 年复兴以来，持有者不断在统一地图上添加新建筑。

works.title: Su Squares
works.description: Ten thousand ERC-721 squares, each 10×10 pixels, that owners personalise with an image, title and link; together they form one large mosaic on the project homepage.
works.description_zh: 一万个 ERC-721 方格，每个 10×10 像素，由持有者配上图像、标题和链接；它们在项目首页上拼成一幅大马赛克。
works.idea_en: Each owner paints one tile of a picture no one controls.
works.idea_zh: 每位持有者只画一格，整幅画无人掌控。
works.protocol: Anyone can mint an available square (0.5 ETH on the current site). The owner can personalise it with a 10×10 image without transparency or animation, a title up to 64 bytes and a URL up to 96 bytes, for a small fee; the homepage image refreshes hourly.
works.protocol_zh: 任何人都可以铸造一个尚未售出的方格（当前网站价格 0.5 ETH）。持有者支付少量费用即可为其设置一张 10×10、无透明和动画的图像、最长 64 字节的标题和最长 96 字节的网址；首页图像每小时刷新一次。
works.collective: The whole square is a continually changing patchwork of owners' images and links.
works.collective_zh: 整幅方阵是由持有者的图像和链接拼成、不断变化的拼贴。

works.title: CryptoKitties
works.description: A blockchain game launched on 28 November 2017 in which players buy, breed and trade virtual cats whose genomes pass traits to their offspring.
works.description_zh: 2017 年 11 月 28 日上线的区块链游戏，玩家购买、繁殖和交易虚拟猫，猫的基因组会把特征遗传给后代。
works.idea_en: Supply grows from players' breeding choices, and a crowd can clog a whole network.
works.idea_zh: 供应量来自玩家的繁殖选择，而一群人足以堵塞整个网络。
works.protocol: Each cat is an NFT with a 256-bit genome of 'cattributes'. Any cat can act as matron or sire; breeding creates a new cat whose generation is one higher than its parents and whose cooldown grows with each breeding, capped at one week. Every action costs Ether.
works.protocol_zh: 每只猫都是一个带有 256 位“猫属性”基因组的 NFT。任何一只猫都可以作为母方或父方；繁殖会生出一只比父母高一代的新猫，冷却时间随每次繁殖增加，最长一周。每个操作都需要支付以太币。
works.collective: Players' breeding produced the herd and its rarities; in December 2017 the game's popularity congested Ethereum, pushing transactions to an all-time high. The cat Genesis sold for 246.9255 ETH that month.
works.collective_zh: 玩家的繁殖造就了猫群及其稀有度；2017 年 12 月游戏的火爆造成以太坊拥堵，交易量创下历史新高。当月名为 Genesis 的猫以 246.9255 ETH 售出。

works.title: Hic et Nunc
works.description: An open NFT platform on Tezos, launched on 1 March 2021, whose cheap minting drew a large global community of artists; its founder shut the website on 11 November 2021, but the contracts kept running.
works.description_zh: 2021 年 3 月 1 日上线的 Tezos 开放 NFT 平台，低廉的铸造成本吸引了一个庞大的全球艺术家社群；创始人于 2021 年 11 月 11 日关闭网站，但合约仍在运行。
works.idea_en: Build the platform as public infrastructure so that it can persist beyond its maker's will.
works.idea_zh: 把平台建成公共基础设施，让它能在创造者的意志之外继续存在。
works.protocol: Anyone can mint OBJKTs (FA2 tokens on IPFS) and list them through the swap contract with creator royalties. From launch to mid-April 2021 each purchase of 1 tez earned 0.5 hDAO for the buyer and 0.5 for the seller, a governance token used to curate the feed.
works.protocol_zh: 任何人都可以铸造 OBJKT（存于 IPFS 的 FA2 代币），并通过 swap 合约挂售，附带创作者版税。从上线到 2021 年 4 月中旬，每 1 tez 的购买会给买卖双方各分配 0.5 hDAO，这是一种用于策展信息流的治理代币。
works.collective: Users reached 100,000 minted OBJKTs in three months and 500,000 in eight, with about 50,000 artists and collectors; events like #OBJKT4OBJKT had artists swap works for free. When the site went down, the community kept using the contracts through mirror sites and founded Teia.
works.collective_zh: 用户在三个月内铸造了 10 万个 OBJKT，八个月时达到 50 万个，社群约有 5 万名艺术家和藏家；#OBJKT4OBJKT 等活动让艺术家免费互换作品。网站关闭后，社群通过镜像站继续使用合约，并创立了 Teia。

works.title: Teia
works.description: The community-run continuation of Hic et Nunc: volunteers kept its contracts and data alive after November 2021, chose the name Teia by on-chain vote and became a non-profit DAO LLC in 2023.
works.description_zh: Hic et Nunc 的社群延续：2021 年 11 月后志愿者维持其合约和数据运转，通过链上投票选定 Teia 之名，并于 2023 年成为非营利 DAO LLC。
works.idea_en: When the author walks away, the users can take over the protocol.
works.idea_zh: 作者离开之后，用户可以接管协议。
works.protocol: Teia operates from 11 November 2021 on the same OBJKT contracts. New swaps carry a 2.5% fee (from March 2023) paid to the community multisig; the community voted to mint 8 million TEIA governance tokens, and holders can poll and vote through DAO contracts while a core-team multisig remains legally responsible during the beta.
works.protocol_zh: Teia 自 2021 年 11 月 11 日起沿用同一套 OBJKT 合约运作。新挂单（自 2023 年 3 月起）收取 2.5% 费用，付给社群多签钱包；社群投票决定铸造 800 万枚 TEIA 治理代币，持有者可以通过 DAO 合约发起投票，测试期间由核心团队多签钱包承担法律责任。
works.collective: Artists, developers and collectors rebuilt the platform after 2.5 months of discussion, pinned millions of files (about 2.36 million pins, 6 TB, in April 2023), ran fundraisers such as #Tezos4Iran and #SavePakistan, and claimed about 3 million TEIA tokens in the first distribution.
works.collective_zh: 艺术家、开发者和藏家经过两个半月的讨论重建了平台，固定了数以百万计的文件（2023 年 4 月约 236 万个固定、6 TB），组织了 #Tezos4Iran、#SavePakistan 等募捐，并在首次分发中领取了约 300 万枚 TEIA 代币。

works.title: Hashd0x | Proof of War
works.description: Open-source software and hardware prototypes, made in response to the war in Ukraine, that register tamper-proof 'hashmarks' of photos and videos on public blockchains, shown with installations including a 3D rendering of a house in Bucha.
works.description_zh: 为回应乌克兰战争而做的开源软硬件原型：把照片和视频的防篡改“哈希标记”登记到公共区块链上，并配合装置展出，其中包括布查镇一栋房屋的三维渲染。
works.idea_en: In an age of synthetic images, build tools that let a crowd compute truth, not only fiction.
works.idea_zh: 在合成图像的时代，打造让群体能够“计算真相”、而不只是计算虚构的工具。
works.protocol: A dedicated camera (Raspberry Pi with telephoto lens) or a mobile app records an image and, at the same moment, writes a hashmark (content hash, metadata, timestamp and the attestant's signature) through smart contracts to public blockchains, with files kept on decentralised storage (Ethereum Swarm). Anyone can later check an image's provenance against its hashmark.
works.protocol_zh: 专用相机（配长焦镜头的 Raspberry Pi）或手机应用在拍摄的同时，通过智能合约把哈希标记（内容哈希、元数据、时间戳和见证者签名）写入公共区块链，文件存放在去中心化存储（Ethereum Swarm）上。之后任何人都可以用哈希标记核验图像来源。
works.collective: The protocol is meant to be used by citizen journalists and open-source investigators, who build a trust network by attesting and validating each other's imagery. Companion works extend the series: Decentralised Embargo mines Ethereum on Gazprom Germania electricity and sends the coins to Ukraine's official crypto wallet, and Uncensorship Architecture stores banned journalistic archives across thousands of nodes. It received an Honorary Mention in the 2023 S+T+ARTS Prize.
works.collective_zh: 该协议面向公民记者和开源调查者，他们通过相互见证和验证图像建立信任网络。系列中的其他作品延伸了这一思路：Decentralised Embargo 用 Gazprom Germania 供应的电力挖以太坊，并把币直接转入乌克兰官方加密钱包；Uncensorship Architecture 把被封禁的新闻档案分布存储在数千个节点上。作品获 2023 年 S+T+ARTS 奖荣誉提名。

leads.name: EtherRock (2017)
leads.why: 100 rocks with a rising mint price and in-contract market, but the author is anonymous, so it fails the authored-protocol test.

leads.name: Eve Sussman, 89 Seconds Atomized (Snark.art, 2018)
leads.why: Video split into 2,500 tokens; owners can borrow atoms to reassemble the film — a co-ownership rule. Needs a primary source and image.

leads.name: Jennifer & Kevin McCoy, Public Key/Private Key (Whitney, 2019)
leads.why: Uses Monegraph to make 50 people museum donors of the work.

leads.name: Scarab Experiment (2015)
leads.why: Counterparty project that is both an artist collective and an artwork.

leads.name: Coin Artist (Marguerite deCourcelle), Bitcoin puzzle paintings (2015–)
leads.why: Paintings hiding bitcoin keys that crowds race to solve; collective solving is the work.

leads.name: Memorychain (2017)
leads.why: Community-driven Counterparty card initiative in Asia, similar to Rare Pepe, with daily/thematic rules.

leads.name: Bitcorn (2018)
leads.why: Counterparty simulation game: players harvest farms or publish corn meme cards over four years.

leads.name: Pixel Map (2016) and WeiCards (2017)
leads.why: Early Ethereum shared canvases with buy/rent rules, like the Million Ether Homepage; check authorship.

leads.name: Conlan Rios, NFT-Scribe (2019)
leads.why: Contract that lets ERC-721 owners append on-chain messages to their tokens.

leads.name: Kevin Abosch, Yellow Lambo (2018)
leads.why: Neon sculpture of a token address sold to one buyer; no collective rule.

leads.name: Sarah Meyohas, Cloud of Petals (2017)
leads.why: Sixteen workers archived 100,000 rose petals and each chose the most beautiful petal per rose; a labour protocol now backing Bitchcoin.

leads.name: Moxie Marlinspike, First Derivative (2021)
leads.why: dApp for creating and trading NFT derivatives that track an underlying NFT.

leads.name: Mitchell F. Chan, Digital Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility (2017)
leads.why: Already in onchain-pak (ritual burn destroys ETH from the artist's contract).
